pageTitle: Klacks for the UAE | Shift Optimization, Not Another HRIS

hero.badge: For hospitals, security & facility operators in the UAE
hero.titleHtml: Keep your HR system. Fix your shift planning.
hero.subtitle: Zoho, ZenHR and similar platforms handle WPS filing, visas and contracts well — but their built-in schedulers weren't built for real 24/7 rotations. Klacks is the specialised optimisation engine that feeds your existing payroll, not another silo.
hero.screenshotCaption: Screenshot shown in German — the core app interface ships in German, English, French and Italian; the Klacksy AI assistant additionally understands Arabic.

challenges.title: The optimisation gap in existing HR suites

items.title: Schedulers built as an afterthought
items.text: All-in-one HR platforms handle visas, contracts and WPS filing well, but their shift planners are little more than static spreadsheets.

items.title: Manual overtime & allowance tracking
items.text: Night, holiday and split-shift allowances get tracked by hand, then re-typed into payroll.

items.title: Saturday/Sunday week since 2022
items.text: Wards, guard posts and facility teams still need gap-free coverage across the (relatively new) Saturday/Sunday weekend.

solutions.title: How Klacks fits into your existing stack
solutions.subtitle: Best-of-breed, not another all-in-one compromise.

items.title: Purpose-built shift optimisation
items.text: Klacks solves the hard 24/7 rotation math that generic HR schedulers can't.

items.title: Export straight into your payroll
items.text: Klacks already exports finished hours, overtime and allowances to CSV/Excel; a ready-made Zoho Books journal-import preset is next on our roadmap.

items.title: Instant replacement on absence
items.text: The Recovery Engine finds the best qualified stand-in the moment a shift is short-staffed.

items.title: Saturday/Sunday week built in
items.text: Calendar rules handle the current weekend pattern natively — no manual recalculation.

items.title: On-premise data residency
items.text: Klacks can run entirely on your own infrastructure wherever data residency matters.

klacksy.title: Klacksy: the assistant built into your team's workflow
klacksy.text: Klacksy isn’t a bolted-on marketing chatbot — it’s embedded directly in the Klacks interface. Staff and schedulers ask about shifts via chat, request shift swaps, or resolve qualification conflicts within the team. A built-in skills and rules system ensures Klacksy only ever suggests changes that actually match the qualifications and working-time limits of the people involved.
